Drawback: Finite Fuel.name: Drawback: Finite Fuel
Drawback: Finite Fuel.description:
⛽ Your Quirk burns something you must take in or carry: sugar, water, salt, fat, iron or a stored material.

⚠️ Run low and it sputters; run dry and it stops.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Momo Yaoyorozu (Creation), Rikido Sato (Sugar Rush).

🎒 Starts with: Quirk fuel pack ×5, Fuel belt
Drawback: Finite Fuel.traitNarrativeEffects: The Quirk burns a physical fuel the user takes in or carries, matching the family (water for water, sugar for a strength boost, fat for creation, iron for metal) unless the player names another plain substance; once set, it stays. Quirk Strain 60 (50 for an Exceptional Quirk): reserves low; hunger, dry mouth, light-headedness, shrinking output. Quirk Strain 80: the drawback is active; only light uses work reliably; bigger ones fail unless the user first takes a Quirk fuel pack (a moment's action) to carry that use through. Packs do not lower Strain. Quirk Strain 100: empty; the Quirk gives out and will not restart until Strain is below 60; the user is shaky, pale and faint. Each pack is used up when taken; more cost money; the Fuel belt keeps them at hand. Signs fade as Strain drops below each threshold. Ordinary life: always carries fuel, eats or drinks on a schedule, budgets for it, frets when supplies run short. Quirkless: no effect; packs are snacks.
